title: Marlowe & Finch Home Delivery Booking Status Limits for Full-Refund Cancellation and Service Level Upgrade
content:
A Marlowe & Finch Home Delivery booking moves through the statuses scheduled, out for delivery, delivered, failed attempt and cancelled. Two terms of each service level are set by status: the last status in which a cancellation refunds all delivery charges, and the last status in which the service level can be upgraded.

## Status limits by service level

| Service level | Last status in which a cancellation refunds all delivery charges | Last status in which the service level can be upgraded |
|---|---|---|
| Curbside Delivery | Scheduled | Scheduled |
| Threshold Delivery | Scheduled | Scheduled |
| Room of Choice Delivery | Scheduled | Scheduled |
| White Glove Delivery | Scheduled | Scheduled |
| White Glove Delivery with Assembly | Scheduled | Scheduled |
| Premier White Glove with Haul-Away | Scheduled | Scheduled |

Both limits are the scheduled status at every level.

## The statuses in brief

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Scheduled | The booking is made and has a delivery date; this is also the status after a new date is booked following a failed attempt |
| Out for delivery | The truck is loaded and dispatched on the scheduled date |
| Delivered | The team has completed the delivery and the customer has signed or confirmed |
| Failed attempt | The delivery could not be completed: nobody was home after the wait time, or the item could not be brought in |
| Cancelled | The booking has been cancelled |

## Position of each status against the limits

| Status | Within the limit for a full-refund cancellation | Within the limit for a service level upgrade |
|---|---|---|
| Scheduled | Yes | Yes |
| Out for delivery | No | No |
